scope: Git tracked and nonignored files; image paths indicative of review/acceptance/evidence/browser QA. Basename references are conservative candidates, not definitive consumers.

policy.screenshots: failure only plus representative final screenshots
policy.incrementalVerification: reuse only exact dependency digest + checker/environment/fixture match; invalidate transitive dependents; missing or incomplete manifest reruns
policy.archive: No moves/deletes now. Retain referenced and accepted evidence. Propose hash-manifest archive with original paths, receipt links and verified recovery; exact duplicates require a retained authority copy and migrated references before deletion.
policy.cleanup: Human approval per item; unreferenced does not mean obsolete
